scientific_integrity: The pointwise activity criterion is previously known and expressly credited. The new assessed claim is an exact all-coloring cactus distribution and a linked arithmetic two-rate saturation window. All computations are reproducible from included standalone source; all independent validation remains unperformed.
scientific_limitations: Distribution is of limiting temporal excitation rates after uniformly random initial coloring, not transient first-entry times or primitive orbit lengths. Mathematical proof depends on a previously published finite-graph circulation theorem. Finite-state verification does not replace the unbounded-graph proof. Historical priority has not been independently established.
title: Arithmetic saturation clocks for three-color excitable dynamics on cactus graphs
